English.Char_Desc_250: HabitLaunch is an Android habit tracker focused on finishing a real habit session, not empty checkmarks. Create one tiny habit, start the session, and finish it after install. Built for consistency, not vanity streaks.
English.Char_Desc_450: HabitLaunch is an Android habit tracker for people who abandon streak apps after setup. Focused on the first three minutes after install: actually complete a session instead of decorating a streak. English.Char_Desc_2000:
HabitLaunch is an Android habit tracker focused on a simple outcome: actually completing a habit session, not collecting empty checkmarks.
Most habit apps reward setup - pretty icons, long lists, streak theater. HabitLaunch is aimed at the first three minutes after install: create one tiny habit, start the session, and finish it. That completed session is the product's aha. Streaks and consistency matter, but only after you've proven you can finish once.
Who it's for: people who've abandoned trackers because logging felt like homework, and builders who want an honest first-run. Install from Google Play, open the app, complete one habit session (about two minutes), and note anything that felt sticky or confusing.
Package: com.sheepdontmoo.habitlaunch. Developer: supadesign. Free to install with optional IAP for unlimited habits. No account required. No ads.
